text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the concert, Smart Falcon notices Mihono Bourbon in the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bourbon relates that she can't comprehend what exactly she felt at our previous concert, but something was telling her to come again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Deciphering Bourbon's confusion as the desire to convey her feelings to others, Falcon invites her to take part in our project.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having felt the power of song for herself, Bourbon decides to join the team.
